_synthetic: Fabricated fixture. ACME Holdings LLC / John Q. Sample at 123 Example St, Denton TX; account numbers are XXXX-masked placeholders, every telephone is in the 555-01XX block reserved for fiction, and every figure is invented. No real taxpayer, institution or account is referenced.
_no_wellformed_ssn: The two SSN cells carry 000-00-0000 and 000-00-0001. The SSA has never issued and will never issue an area number of 000, and never issues a group number of 00, so both fail SSN validity on two independent counts and cannot collide with a living person the way a plausible-looking test value can. The EIN is 00-0000000, whose 00 prefix is likewise never assigned. The PII rule covers intermediates: no fixture, fetched-record file, log or review page may carry a real SSN, and no fixture may contain a well-formed one.
_saturation: This fixture exists to reach EVERY mapped text cell, which is what --saturated checks. A real record does not; the production-mode run against the same map is the one that reports which slots a real record left empty. Every group is filled to its last printed slot on purpose.
433f_tp_name: ACME Holdings LLC — John Q. Sample
_accounts_split: Was one `accounts` array of three rows until defect D1. The map binds PERSONAL BANK ACCOUNTS and INVESTMENTS as separate groups, so the fixture supplies them separately — which is the point: the flat array could not say which table a row belonged in, and slot order answered for it.

bank_accounts.institution: Second Example Credit Union, Denton TX

_digital_assets_now_bound: Was `_deferred_digital_assets` — a row deliberately printing nowhere, kept so the read-back could prove a crypto wallet was not diverted into a table that WAS bound. The table is bound now, so the row is a real row and the proof it carried is retired.
_digital_asset_value_maxlen: The value column is /MaxLen 12 and the form's own printed example beside it, '10 Bitcoins $64,600 USD', is 23 characters — the cell cannot hold the example the IRS prints next to it. Both values below are exactly 12 characters, the longest the cell accepts. Anything longer stops the run and names the cell; it is never truncated.
_refinance_is_scalar: The refinance pair is bound as two scalars per printed row, not as `real_estate` row columns — see 433f.map.json _notes v7 and crosswalk arguable A2-2. A caller supplying the array supplies these alongside it.
_final_payment_is_a_split: 'Date of Final Payment (mo/yr)' is two cells, each /MaxLen 2. These values are mo/yr with a TWO-digit year, which is all the form holds; the split writes nothing and stops the run unless the stripped value is exactly four digits, so 06/2027 would fail loudly rather than printing '20' as the year.
_section_e_row_shapes: accounts_receivable and credit_cards_accepted use the SHARED row classes' own column names, so a row fetched from irs433_accounts_notes_receivable or irs433_credit_cards_accepted feeds them directly. The receivable money column is `amount_due` — the class's key — even though this form prints the header 'Amount Owed'.
